meta.name: update-component-reference
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to add components (commands, agents, skills, hooks, or MCP servers) to the Component Reference section of the website.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将命令、技能或 MCP 服务器添加到网站组件参考区
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要维护网站上的组件目录
copy.tagline_en: Add commands, skills, or MCP servers to the component reference page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a component directory on a website

howto.what: 当用户要求为Claude Code组件（命令、代理、技能、钩子、MCP服务器）添加文档时，Claude会检查组件是否存在，然后在网站Component Reference部分创建对应的MDX文件，并填入规范、配置等信息。
howto.when: 用户要求将新的命令、代理、技能、钩子或MCP服务器添加到网站的Component Reference文档时。

say.text: 帮我给新技能'skill-creator'添加文档。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to add documentation for Claude Code components (commands, agents, skills, hooks, MCP servers), Claude checks if the component exists, then creates the corresponding MDX file in the Component Reference section with specifications, configurations, etc.
howto.when_en: When the user requests to add a new command, agent, skill, hook, or MCP server to the Component Reference documentation on the website.

say_en.text: Add documentation for the new skill 'skill-creator'.
Add the @pair-programmer agent to Component Reference.
say_en.note: Claude will create agent doc with spec import.
